title: Whispers at the Well
text: The miller's wife swears the river folk downstream are coughing blood. The reeve calls it idle talk, but he will not drink from the well today.

choices.label: Warn Hilde the baker
choices.hint: She sells to half the village.
choices.followUp: Hilde goes pale, then nods. 'I'll boil the water. Tell no one I was scared.'

choices.label: Go downstream and see
choices.hint: Risky, but you would know the truth.
choices.followUp: You take the river path while the bells start to ring.

canonFacts: The coughing sickness has reached the villages downstream of Millford.
Millford's reeve fears the well is tainted.
